_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit. Run `npm run discover` first to see your real checkout question labels, then match them exactly in 'match' below.

emailRouting._comment: Team members: sync one contact, using their own email/name questions, tagged 'Staff'.
Campers: sync the camper as a contact (tagged 'Camp Attendee'), plus a second contact for the parent/carer ONLY if their email differs from the camper's. The tag applies to both contacts.

mergeFieldMap._comment: Every attendee gets these from their ticket record, not a checkout question
Maps a checkout question's answer straight into a Mailchimp merge field (create this merge field in Mailchimp first: Audience > Settings > Audience fields)
